reason: We don't buy this today and I'm not opening a new budget line for it. They want 50% up front and then 30 days, and I pay my suppliers at 60 to 90 days. At about 19 euro a square metre on top of my own labour it is more than the damage it saves me.
objection: Deposit up front, a credit check, and 19 euro a m2 for something I can cover with film and tape for a fraction of that. My cash is tied up in the job and I don't pay suppliers deposits.
instead: Keep doing what I do now: cheap protection film and tape from the local hardware store, and care on site. Pay for a glazing repair or replacement when something gets damaged.
would_change_my_mind: A client or developer on a premium block who insists on it and pays for it as a separate line item, on 60 day terms with no deposit.
